posts.text: Blood Pressure Checks — PharmaConnect: Do I need an appointment or can I walk in? Some pharmacies offer walk-in checks; others prefer you to book so a consultation room and staff time can be set aside. Call 01709 210731 (Rotherham).
Blood Pressure Checks — PharmaConnect: I am under 40 but my parent had high blood pressure — can I still get checked?
Blood Pressure Checks — PharmaConnect: What if I am not eligible for the NHS service?
Blood Pressure Checks — PharmaConnect: Will one high reading mean I have high blood pressure? No. Call 01709 210731 (Rotherham).
PharmaConnect: Patients choose pharmacy blood pressure checks because they offer convenient access to screening without waiting for a routine GP appointment. Call 01709 210731 (Rotherham).
Blood Pressure Checks — PharmaConnect: The service gives a clear outcome in one visit: a explained result, a record for your own files, and a defined next step. Call 01709 210731 (Rotherham).

Blood Pressure Checks — PharmaConnect: One high reading means I have hypertension. Diagnosis requires confirmed repeated measurements and GP assessment — not a single clinic or home reading. Call 01709 210731 (Rotherham).

Blood Pressure Checks — PharmaConnect: High blood pressure always causes symptoms. Many people with raised blood pressure feel completely well. That is why screening exists. Call 01709 210731 (Rotherham).

Blood Pressure Checks — PharmaConnect: The pharmacy will put me on blood pressure tablets. Pharmacists screen and refer. Starting or adjusting long-term treatment is your GP's role. Call 01709 210731 (Rotherham).
